title: In range
description:
Write `bool inRange(int value, int low, int high)` that returns `true` when `value` is at least `low` and at most `high`.

In maths you can write `low <= value <= high`. In C++ that compiles but means something else. Write two comparisons joined with `&&`.
hints: `low <= value <= high` compiles, but it compares `low <= value` first (giving `true` or `false`, which is 1 or 0) and then compares that 0 or 1 with `high`.
Write it as two separate questions joined by "and": is `value` at least `low`, and is `value` at most `high`?
